headline: RapWire 24/7: Blueface, Jay-Z, Swae Lee, K. Michelle and GTA VI's Justice score
body: RapWire's verified Oct. 20 morning carousel covers Blueface's Santa Clarita arrest, Puck's Jay-Z Super Bowl LXI report, Swae Lee's Miami estate sale, K. Michelle's country debut and Rockstar's Justice score reveal for GTA VI. Each slide uses original subject-led late-1980s editorial comic art with complete readable on-art reporting, no top banner and the official transparent RapWire mark.

caption:
1) Blueface was arrested in Santa Clarita after deputies responded to a report of a gunman at a Valencia business on Oct. 19. Authorities later determined the call was a bogus swatting incident, while a sheriff’s representative said he was booked for allegedly refusing commands during the investigation. @bluefacebabyy
2) Puck reports Jay-Z selected himself to headline Super Bowl LXI at SoFi Stadium in February 2027, with TMZ also citing the report. The NFL and Roc Nation had not officially announced the booking as of Oct. 20, so the performance remains reported rather than confirmed. @jayonce
3) Swae Lee sold his South Miami estate for $4.35 million after listing it for $5.395 million in July. The seven-bedroom property includes a 15-car garage, sports courts and a pool, and the closing price was only about $100,000 above what he paid in 2023. @swaelee
4) K. Michelle’s debut country album Jesus & Whiskey is out now through Real Outlawz Records and BBR Music Group. She told interviewers a late R&B song missed the nine-track album, making the project a deliberate Nashville crossover rather than a break from her voice. @kmichelle
5) Rockstar’s official GTA VI music page confirms French electronic duo Justice as the game’s original-score composers, and the team’s single “Flower in a Hurricane” is out ahead of the Nov. 19 launch. The reveal gives the game a distinct electronic identity alongside its in-world radio and podcast lineup. @rockstargames

@Rapwire247
